scientific_integrity: The generating functions are proved using an exact small-integer matrix certificate and Cayley-Hamilton, not an extrapolation from finite observations. Independent external validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The source word is alternating and the deleted subsequence has length exactly three. An exact finite-state proof and bounded independent enumeration are supplied. No results are claimed for arbitrary sources or patterns of other lengths; an unindexed priority equivalent remains possible.
title: Exact three-symbol complement-deletion spectra of finite alternating binary words
